items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: You didn't get paid when you were working with Harry Moran? Yeah. But the money wasn't much though.

ctx.x: Yeah. So we don't hear much of you before, say you started with the George Lewis band. Is that one of the first professional jobs you played? With George. With George. Yeah. That was the first professional jobs.
You didn't get paid when you were working with Harry Moran?
Yeah. But the money wasn't much though. It was five dollars or something like that, you know. Yeah.
